entities.summary: "Zangaléwa" is a 1986 song by Cameroonian makossa group Golden Sounds, who later changed its name to "Zangalewa", just as the song itself, thanks to its success. The band's members were Jean Paul Zé Bella, Victor Dooh Belley, Emile Kojidie, and Annie Anzouer.
